run_rise_saliency: run the RISE attribution method on a PyTorch model to compute saliency maps
get_example_data: get example model and input data from the torchray benchmark module
plot_example_saliency: plot a saliency map visualization for a given input and category
get_device: get the best available device GPU or CPU for running PyTorch models
compute_saliency_map: compute a saliency map for a specific category using the RISE method
